title: Story premise EDU033: The Example Loses Its Training Wheels
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: This time, one step is missing. What belongs here? Takeaway/theme: Worked examples can become practice when support is deliberately reduced.
description: A learner wants to solve a new worked problem, but copying every displayed step hides which choices are understood. Successively removing selected steps invites the learner to supply and check them.
